scope: Geometry diagnostic followed by fixed public TRAIN RGB cue feasibility only; no new labels or training admission.
selection: Lexicographically first (scene_id,frame_id,instance_id) TRAIN instance per fixed object; record every unavailable VAL object, do not replace it. No image/mask/score selection.
corner_order: AUX_AABB index=4*bitX+2*bitY+bitZ, bit0=min,bit1=max; object-frame official models_info AABB; NOT pallet native8 and NOT snapped to mesh.
geometry_diagnostics: Nearest triangle surface and nearest vertex distances only, no physical corner certification. Fixed vertex-radius diagnostics at1,2,5mm; nearest point not substituted for AABB.
crop: All8 corners each of4 fixed instances; 96 native samples at r+(column/row+.5-48), nearest floor(value+.5), black outside. Raw and marked separate. No crop recenter/snap.
